batches.brief: Convert units u-invoice-history (OW_BILLING.PKG_INVOICING: COMPUTE_PREVIEW, FN_INVOICE_PREVIEW, FN_INVOICE_LINES, SP_ISSUE_INVOICE) and u-rating (OW_BILLING.PKG_RATING: COMPUTE_RATING, FN_USAGE_RATING, FN_USAGE_SUMMARY, SP_FINALIZE_RATING + trigger TRG_USAGE_EVENTS_CHECK). ONE PR PER UNIT — this batch opens two PRs against tp-run/databricks-1793185083, one per unit, never a combined PR. Read .migration/units/u-invoice-history/ and .migration/units/u-rating/ mapping_spec.json + dependencies.json. Tenant One only: tenant_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' (subscription_id '20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'); the filter literal stays in the converted code, not a manifest param. u-rating lands on the lakebase target: WRITABLE native Lakebase tables (no synced tables) usage_events, rating_periods, rating_results in database ow_tp, project ow-tp-billing, branch mig-1793185083 — load path SELECT-only Python against OW_BILLING_RO_DSN -> CSV -> static DDL CREATE TABLE -> psycopg `COPY ... FROM STDIN` using a per-session OAuth credential via generate-database-credential on the unpooled endpoint host (already in target_hosts; the -pooler variant refuses OAuth). No CREATE ROLE. Deploys compute_rating, fn_usage_rating, fn_usage_summary, sp_finalize_rating as same-named Postgres functions plus TRG_USAGE_EVENTS_CHECK as a Postgres trigger, parity proven by the harness. u-invoice-history lands on the databricks target: Delta tables invoice_header, invoice_line, invoices, invoice_lines, credit_notes in ow_tp.mig_1793185083 — load path SELECT-only extract -> CSV -> `databricks fs cp` into a UC volume under ow_tp.mig_1793185083 -> read_files -> CREATE TABLE AS. Deploys compute_preview, fn_invoice_preview, fn_invoice_lines, sp_issue_invoice as same-named Databricks SQL routines with parity. Cross-unit calls into PKG_RATING (COMPUTE_RATING from COMPUTE_PREVIEW, SP_FINALIZE_RATING from SP_ISSUE_INVOICE) are satisfied inside the batch: Delta SQL cannot call Lakebase functions, so the history conversion re-implements the needed rating logic as Databricks SQL and proves parity against Oracle for both the invoicing routines and the re-implemented rating logic. Source is oracle via secret name OW_BILLING_RO_DSN; read-only SELECT only, zero writes to Oracle. Recon per unit with its own target kind: dbx-recon --family oracle --mode live under tolerance profile tol-20261027-v1, pinned to --target-http-path /sql/1.0/warehouses/565cd2fd713738c4 — u-rating with --target-kind lakebase, evidence under .migration/recon/u-rating/; u-invoice-history with --target-kind databricks, evidence under .migration/recon/u-invoice-history/. Gates: recon_pass / recon_pass_rating (row parity per unit), routine_parity / routine_parity_rating (entry-point routines return equivalent results vs source), rerun_proof / rerun_proof_rating (rerun is idempotent per unit).
